item.title: Summary - Tropical Storm Lala (CP2/CP012026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...LALA SLIGHTLY WEAKER... As of 11:00 PM HST Mon Aug 24 the center of Lala was located near 34.7, -175.9 with movement NW at 6 mph. The minimum central pressure was 994 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 50 mph.

item.title: Summary - Remnants of Moke (CP3/CP022026)
item.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
item.description: ...MOKE IS NO LONGER A TROPICAL CYCLONE... ...THIS IS THE FINAL NHC ADVISORY... As of 11:00 PM HST Mon Aug 24 the center of Moke was located near 16.3, -164.1 with movement W at 14 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
